name: Chahlari Ghat Bridge
facts: Chahlari Ghat Bridge, stretching 3,260 metres, ranks as India’s 13th longest river bridge and the longest road bridge over a river in Uttar Pradesh, showcasing impressive engineering across the Ghaghara.
Named Chahlari Ghat Setu in Hindi, the bridge owes its existence to socialist leader Mukhtar Anis, affectionately dubbed 'Ganjer Ke Gandhi', whose advocacy turned vision into concrete reality.
Spanning the Ghaghara River, Chahlari Ghat Bridge links the eastern town of Bahraich to the western city of Sitapur, facilitating smoother travel across Uttar Pradesh’s heartland.
